newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FRENCH FIRST DIVISION WEEKEND PROGRAMME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRENCH FIRST DIVISION WEEKEND PROGRAMME.

text.p: French first division programme
this weekend (league positions in brackets, all kickoff times
GMT):
Friday
Paris St Germain (1) v Marseille (11) 1930
Marseille are slowly recovering after a long spell in the
second division but they are improving and have not lost in
their last three matches.
Leaders Paris St Germain slumped to a 5-3 defeat at Bordeaux
last week and must react positively as second-placed Monaco are
in form and only three points behind.
Saturday
Monaco (2) v Nancy (19) 1900
Despite the absence of injured playmaker Enzo Scifo, Monaco
are doing fine at present and proved it by crushing Hamburg 3-0
in a UEFA Cup third round, first leg on Tuesday.
Nancy a struggling 19th in the 20-strong table.
Auxerre (5) v Bastia (4) 1900
French champions Auxerre, still without young striker Thomas
Deniaud and international midfielder Sabri Lamouchi, have
suffered in their last few outings but they boosted their
confidence on Wednesday with a superb 2-1 win away to Ajax in a
European Champions' League match.
Corsican club Bastia are doing surprisingly well this season
and are looking forward to staying in contention for a place in
Europe.
Metz (6) v Nice (20) 1900
Metz, held 1-1 by English league leaders Newcastle in the
UEFA Cup on Tuesday, should beat bottom club Nice.
Le Havre (15) v Lille (8) 1900
Le Havre need points to escape the relegation zone while
Lille, who made a sensational start to the season, are finding
it hard to keep up with the pace.
Lyon (10) v Bordeaux (3) 1900
Lyon, now coached by former international Bernard Lacombe,
are suffering from the absence of gifted striker Florian
Maurice, out for several months with a bad knee injury.
Bordeaux on a high since their superb 5-3 win over PSG which
allowed them to jump to third.
Lens (12) v Strasbourg (7) 1900
Lens, up with the best after the first few matches, are
slowly sliding down and will be eager to stop the rot against
Strasbourg, hunting a place in Europe.
Cannes (16) v Caen (18) 1900
Tense fight between two clubs struggling to avoid
relegation. Cannes trainer Guy Lacombe is aware that another
defeat could cost him his job.
Guingamp (14) v Rennes (9) 1900
Rennes are confident before this clash between two teams
from Brittany. They beat Auxerre 1-0 last week with a goal by
Stephane Guivarc'h, the league's top scorer on 13.
Montpellier (17) v Nantes (13) 1900
Montpellier in a difficult situation while 1995 champions
Nantes playing well again after a disastrous start.
